name: Pendant-Antipode Extension Criterion
statement: Let $\mathcal K\subseteq2^Y$ be irredundant, well graded, and union closed with complementary states $A,Y\setminus A$. The pendant extension $\mathcal H_A=\{A\}\cup\{B\cup\{e\}:B\in\mathcal K\}$ is irredundant, well graded, and union closed, has a unique antipodal pair, and is a learning-space graph exactly when one endpoint of the base complementary pair is a valid root. When $A$ is a singleton and $\varnothing\in\mathcal K$, $\mathcal H_A$ is itself a positive semicube of an explicit learning-space parent.
proof: The two-link recursion applies with singleton lower link and base upper link. Its antipodal test leaves only the displayed complementary endpoints, so the translated root tests reduce exactly to validity of those two base roots. A second two-link construction with a square lower link supplies the explicit parent.
